subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Recognises digraphs making the 'f' sound ('ph' elephant, 'gh' laugh)

show.line: Listen. f, as in fish. Elephant has that sound too, spelt ph. Laugh has it at the end, spelt gh!

rounds.prompt: Which word has the f sound spelt ph?
Which word ends with the f sound, spelt gh?
This animal is big and grey. It starts with ph, which says f. Say it.
Tap the word that spells photo the right way.
How is the f sound spelt? Sort the words.
Which word has the f sound? Dolphin, dog or duck?

hints: Say the word. Can you hear f? Then look at how it is spelt.
ph and gh can both say f.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will spell the sound in elephant.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: Elephant is spelt with an f in the middle!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Elephant uses ph for the f sound.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's look together. Ele, ph, ant. The ph says f!

parent_line: Can hear the f sound and knows it can be spelt f, ph or gh.
